results.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache | alphaXiv
results.content: This paper's findings are fundamental to the core hypothesis of KIVI. The authors of KIVI explicitly state that their observation of persistent, large-magnitude outliers in fixed channels of the key cache aligns with previous findings in the AWQ paper, providing a critical justification for their decision to quantize the key cache per-channel. [...] KIVI represents a significant advancement in efficient LLM inference by successfully implementing tuning-free 2-bit KV cache quantization with minimal accuracy loss. The work's data-driven methodology—first analyzing distribution patterns, then designing quantization strategies based on these insights—provides a robust foundation for future research in cache compression. [...] This paper is cited as a key related work that also tackles the KV cache bottleneck. KIVI's authors reference FlexGen's use of 4-bit group-wise quantization for both key and value caches, positioning their own asymmetric quantization strategy as a more nuanced and effective approach for lower bit-rates.
